takes.prompt: Clean, modern minimal electronic / tech-pop for a light, precise product teaser (design tool). Bright and optimistic but understated. Instrumentation: soft punchy kick, crisp closed hats, finger snaps, glassy plucked synth arpeggio, warm sub bass, airy pad, a touch of mallet/marimba. Energy arc mapped to the edit: 0–4 s sparse intro (pad + pluck arpeggio, no drums), light build; groove enters with kick and bass at ~4 s; 4–10 s steady mid-energy groove; 10–18 s full groove, rhythmic and bouncy with clear beat accents; 18–19.5 s short lift/riser with drums dropping out; strong final hit at 19.5 s followed by a sustained, resolving chord and airy tail to the end. Tight, polished, wide stereo, lots of space for sound effects. Avoid vocals, heavy distortion, aggressive EDM drops, busy melodies.
